response.basis: Extraction from numbered NL segments NL1-NL8 describing microwave door/cook state machine: DoorShut, DoorOpen, DoorOpenWithItem, DoorShutWithItem, ReadytoCook, Cooking states with transitions, self-loop, effects, and timer action.

binding_hints.reason: The microwave system is the enclosing owner of the initial edge.

contracts.normative_statement: The microwave system must have an initial entry into the DoorShut state.
contracts.quote: The microwave starts in the DoorShut state.
contracts.reason: Explicit start-state clause establishes the required initial pseudostate edge into DoorShut.

contracts.basis: NL1 'remain in DoorShut if a Cancel action is performed'.
contracts.normative_statement: When Cancel is performed in DoorShut, the system must remain in DoorShut.
contracts.quote: the system can either remain in DoorShut if a Cancel action is performed
contracts.reason: NL explicitly requires the state to remain unchanged upon this exact event, an independently violable retention obligation.

contracts.normative_statement: DoorShut must transition to DoorOpen when the door is opened.
contracts.quote: transition to the DoorOpen state when the door is opened
contracts.reason: Explicit source-target endpoint required by NL.

contracts.normative_statement: DoorShut must transition to DoorOpen on Door Opened event.
contracts.quote: When the Door Opened action occurs in the DoorShut state, the system transitions to the DoorOpen state.
contracts.reason: NL2 restates the same endpoint from NL1 with explicit event naming; preserved as its own atomic contract for this segment's coverage.

contracts.normative_statement: DoorOpen must transition to DoorShut when the door is closed.
contracts.quote: The door can be closed to return to the DoorShut state.
contracts.reason: Explicit reverse endpoint stated in this segment.

binding_hints.basis: NL3 'placing an item inside the microwave'

contracts.normative_statement: DoorOpen must transition to DoorOpenWithItem when an item is placed inside.
contracts.quote: placing an item inside the microwave transitions the system to DoorOpenWithItem
contracts.reason: Explicit endpoint on item placement event.

contracts.normative_statement: DoorOpenWithItem must transition to DoorOpen when the item is removed.
contracts.quote: If the item is removed, the system returns to DoorOpen.
contracts.reason: Explicit reverse endpoint on item removal.

binding_hints.reason: Independent data condition co-required with event.

contracts.normative_statement: DoorOpenWithItem must transition to DoorShutWithItem when the door is closed with zero time set.
contracts.quote: the system can transition to DoorShutWithItem if the door is closed with zero time set
contracts.reason: First alternative endpoint sharing source DoorOpenWithItem with an event+guard condition.

contracts.normative_statement: DoorOpenWithItem must transition to ReadytoCook when cooking time is entered.
contracts.quote: or to ReadytoCook if cooking time is entered
contracts.reason: Second alternative endpoint sharing source DoorOpenWithItem.

contracts.normative_statement: The two alternatives from DoorOpenWithItem must be distinguishable/mutually exclusive.
contracts.quote: the system can transition to DoorShutWithItem if the door is closed with zero time set or to ReadytoCook if cooking time is entered
contracts.reason: Two conditioned alternatives sharing one source are intended to be mutually exclusive per the exclusive 'or' framing with distinct conditions.

contracts.normative_statement: DoorShutWithItem must transition to DoorOpenWithItem when the door is opened.
contracts.quote: opening the door transitions the system back to DoorOpenWithItem
contracts.reason: First alternative endpoint from shared source DoorShutWithItem.

contracts.normative_statement: DoorShutWithItem must transition to ReadytoCook when cooking time is entered.
contracts.quote: entering cooking time takes the system to ReadytoCook
contracts.reason: Second alternative endpoint from shared source DoorShutWithItem.

binding_hints.basis: NL5 'cooking time is displayed and updated'

contracts.normative_statement: On entering ReadytoCook, the cooking time must be displayed and updated.
contracts.quote: where the cooking time is displayed and updated
contracts.reason: Independent explicit effect obligation on the cooking-time variable distinct from the endpoint itself.

contracts.normative_statement: ReadytoCook must transition to DoorShutWithItem when Cancel is performed.
contracts.quote: if the Cancel action is performed, the system returns to DoorShutWithItem
contracts.reason: First alternative endpoint from shared source ReadytoCook.

binding_hints.basis: NL6 'canceling or updating the cooking time'

contracts.normative_statement: On the Cancel transition from ReadytoCook to DoorShutWithItem, the cooking time must be canceled or updated.
contracts.quote: canceling or updating the cooking time
contracts.reason: Independent explicit effect tied to the Cancel transition on the cooking-time variable.

contracts.normative_statement: ReadytoCook must transition to DoorOpenWithItem when the door is opened.
contracts.quote: If the door is opened, the system transitions to DoorOpenWithItem.
contracts.reason: Second alternative endpoint from shared source ReadytoCook.

contracts.normative_statement: ReadytoCook must transition to Cooking when Start is performed.
contracts.quote: When the Start action is performed in ReadytoCook, the system transitions to the Cooking state
contracts.reason: Explicit endpoint on Start event.

contracts.normative_statement: On entering Cooking, the timer must start.
contracts.quote: where the timer starts
contracts.reason: Explicit action tied to entering Cooking state, independent of the endpoint contract.

contracts.normative_statement: Cooking must transition to DoorOpenWithItem when the door is opened.
contracts.quote: opening the door stops the timer and the system transitions to DoorOpenWithItem
contracts.reason: First alternative endpoint from shared source Cooking.

binding_hints.reason: Data subject affected, shared with start-timer action.

contracts.normative_statement: On the door-opened transition from Cooking, the timer must stop.
contracts.quote: opening the door stops the timer
contracts.reason: Independent explicit effect (stop timer) tied to this exact transition, sharing the timer variable with the start-timer action.

contracts.normative_statement: Cooking must transition to DoorShutWithItem when the timer expires.
contracts.quote: if the timer expires, the system moves to DoorShutWithItem
contracts.reason: Second alternative endpoint from shared source Cooking.

contracts.normative_statement: Cooking must transition to ReadytoCook when Cancel is performed.
contracts.quote: A Cancel action transitions the system back to ReadytoCook.
contracts.reason: Third alternative endpoint from shared source Cooking.

Containment is not explicitly stated (no NL sentence establishing a composite/substate hierarchy beyond flat states), so no containment contracts are created. No cardinality or region language appears. No explicit termination language appears, so no termination contracts are created; all named states remain operating_state given continuing narrative.
